dog.description_text:
Chowder is a 2 year old Shepherd mix who weighs around 49 lbs, and this handsome guy is quite the charmer! With his sweet, goofy personality, he's pretty hard not to fall in love with. He's a total lovebug who greets new friends with a gentle, friendly hello, and if you're lucky, you might even get a kiss or two! He's also a big fan of other dogs and is already house-trained.

Chowder has plenty of energy, as you'd expect from a young working breed! He's looking for adopters who understand that a happy Shepherd needs more than just a couple of walks around the block. A good mix of physical exercise, mental stimulation, training and a consistent routine will help this smart, affectionate boy thrive. He's got so much love to give and plenty of personality to go with it!

Registered adopters interested in Chowder can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
